Q9012.reason: A blanket negative belief about a group is prejudice (an attitude); the spectator only voiced a thought, not an act of discrimination.

Q9013.reason: Misrepresentation requires reliance and pecuniary loss, and the pedestrian rejected the offer and recovered a full verdict, so the false statement caused no monetary loss.

Q9014.reason: Under the prevailing agency theory, felony murder does not apply when a co-felon is killed by a third party such as police rather than by a co-felon.
